```
def _assign_op(dest, op, arg, val, path, scope):
    try:
        if op == '.':
            setattr(dest, arg, val)
        elif op == '[':
            dest[arg] = val
        elif op == 'P':
            # Path assignment - use the target registry to get the appropriate handler
            handler = scope[TargetRegistry].get_handler('assign', dest, path=path)
            handler(dest, arg, val)
        else:
            # For other operations, treat as direct assignment
            dest[arg] = val
    except Exception as e:
        raise PathAssignError(e, path, arg)
```
